query: Can I still receive top-ups if I have started my monthly retirement payouts?
reference_answer: Yes, you can receive top-ups as long as you have not reached thecurrent Enhanced Retirement Sum.Find outhow much top-ups you can receive.
answer: If you've started monthly retirement payouts, you may not be able to receive top-ups due to the restrictions placed on your account once payouts begin. [Document N]
